intended_object: The canonical isomorphism, for a connected category C, between the colimit in `Type w` of the constant functor with value the one-point set and the one-point set `PUnit`. Taken from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The definition is the unique-up-to-isomorphism comparison between the chosen colimit cocone of `constPUnitFunctor C` and the cocone `pUnitCocone`. The cocone `pUnitCocone` is a colimit by `isColimitPUnitCocone`, which needs `IsConnected C`. That is the natural map. Connectedness (nonempty and preconnected) is exactly what the statement needs: if C is empty the colimit is the empty set, and if C is not preconnected the colimit has more than one point. So the hypothesis is the right one, and the universe parameters are arbitrary. This is the general statement as Mathlib itself has it in this file. No other Mathlib declaration gives the same isomorphism.
